records.requirement: WhatsApp-first LMMM Dept-35 AI Maintenance Agent; PostgreSQL source of truth; plant-wide extensible hierarchy.
Exact identifiers preserved; fuzzy search never mutates Equipment/SAP/Drawing/Part/CAT/Manual/SMP/SOP identifiers.
Upload does not mean permanent Store; explicit Save/Store intent required.
Every operational entry captures approved submitter identity and actual server timestamp; event date/time/shift separate.
Missing or uncertain mappings remain Needs Review/Unresolved; never guess.
Search priority: Exact ID → Canonical Name → Alias → Abbreviation → Transliteration → Fuzzy → Semantic → Conversation Context.
Unified equipment timeline links Inspection, Defect, Job, Breakdown, History, PM, CBM, Spares, Shutdown and Measurements.
LMMM Data and General Engineering Reference remain separate; internet/general knowledge never auto-becomes plant master fact.
